summary: Resolve published validation before counting historical adoption tickets

delivery.outcome: Fresh published checkouts with successive same-target adoptions validate only their latest integration instead of rejecting historical tickets as concurrent writers.
nonGoals: No terminal ticket authority or historical status changes.
No weakened handling of dirty, unpublished or differently targeted adoptions.
No target-repository code or report changes here.

architecture.decision: For a nonempty set of adoption records targeting the same branch, reuse the exact clean-published first-parent observation before applying the active adoption cardinality check. If publication cannot be proven, preserve the previous single-adoption fallback or ambiguity failure.
architecture.rollback: Adopt the prior immutable standard revision through a separately validated delivery.

validation.evidence: Real-Git positive tests for two, three and many same-target historical adoptions; negative dirty/untracked/unpublished/ambiguous-target tests.
Full standard contract, protected Linux/Windows checks and independent review; atomic 0.20.22 release projections.
